newsitem.title: JORDAN: NO JORDAN O/NITE INTERBANK MARKET TRADES - C. BANK.
newsitem.headline: NO JORDAN O/NITE INTERBANK MARKET TRADES - C. BANK.

text.p: Jordan's central bank said there were no reported trades on the overnight dinar interbank market on Tuesday for the second time this week.
The last weighted average overnight interbank rate stood at 6.46 percent on Saturday. There were no deals on Sunday and a public holiday on Monday shut all banks.

Bankers said a market awash with surplus dinar funds was mainly due to maturing CDs that entered the banking system last Saturday, helping to depress rates and leave few incentives for banks to lend in the absence of any real demand.
